claims: The 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four takes place on Saturday, April 4, 2026.
The 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four takes place at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis.
The 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four is broadcast on TBS, TNT, and truTV.
Game 1 of the 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four is (2) UConn vs. (3) Illinois at 6:09 p.m. ET.
Game 2 of the 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four is (1) Arizona vs. (1) Michigan at approximately 9:19 p.m. ET.
Streaming options for the 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four are March Madness Live app, HBO Max, Sling TV, DirectTV.
The 2026 Men's NCAA National Championship takes place on Monday, April 6, 2026.
The 2026 Men's NCAA National Championship is between the winner of Game 1 and the winner of Game 2.
The 2026 Men's NCAA National Championship begins at approximately 7:30 p.m. ET.
The 2026 Men's NCAA National Championship is broadcast on TBS
